answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the pulse graph. Re-attestations are stored in tundra and nebula lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 3 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 948 account sybil into a 3 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
